facts.business: Wonderla Holidays Limited operates amusement parks and resort hospitality in India, with parks in Bengaluru, Kochi, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Bhubaneswar, and a resort offering at Bengaluru.

capacity_or_capex.item: The ISLE glamping pods at Bengaluru

key_risks: Higher cost pressures from commissioning of new parks (Chennai park and The ISLE)
Performance of Bhubaneswar park not aligning with Board-approved financial projections
Impairment risk for Bhubaneswar park if key assumptions change
